Renewal Help
fields.options:
Azure client secrets expire (6, 12 or 24 months, chosen when the secret is created). When it expires, Microsoft rejects every token request with AADSTS7000222 and all Engineering Legals SharePoint syncs stop: per-record uploads, the monthly folder job and the monthly frequency sync.

  1. Azure portal → App registrations → the app whose Application (client) ID matches Client ID above.
  2. Certificates & secrets → New client secret. Pick an expiry and note it.
  3. Copy the secret Value immediately (Azure only shows it once) into Client Secret above, and set Client Secret Expires On.
  4. Save, then click Test Connection.
  5. Delete the old secret in Azure once the test succeeds.

Records that failed to sync are retried automatically every night at 02:00 (up to 200 per night, oldest first).
